CSV needs a date column, a note/description column and an amount/INR column. If an Income/Expense column exists, only expenses are used (works with the Kaggle “My Expenses Data” file).
Categoriser trained on 100,000 transactions from the Hugging Face “transaction-categorization” dataset (+ its category keyword list). All inference runs in your browser; no data leaves the page.
